objective:
Use the **mythos-prod Bridge** as the control/orchestration layer for the complete SPY V2 program.

The Bridge must NOT attempt to edit or commit code in the external `othoth77/spy` repository from the mythos-prod worktree. Its responsibility is to correctly prepare, dispatch, track, and verify the SPY V2 execution through an authorized executor/agent that has access to `othoth77/spy`.
notes:
Source: GitHub Issue #473 https://github.com/othoth77/mythos-prod/issues/473 — "[SPY V2] Master Task #1 — Bridge Orchestration & Delegated Execution"

requested_action: investigate — source default (written as "investigate"): defaulted to "investigate" because the Issue did not state one (add `Action: implement|document|test|review|investigate` or a label `action:<x>`). → execution profile repo-read

[critical repository boundary]
- Bridge repository: `othoth77/mythos-prod`
- Target implementation repository: `othoth77/spy`
- The mythos-prod Bridge must remain within its own worktree.
- Do not create SPY implementation files or commits in mythos-prod.
- Do not misclassify this task as a report-only investigation.

[required execution profile]
This is an **orchestration / delegated-execution task**, not `repo-read`.

The Bridge must:
1. Validate the SPY V2 master objective.
2. Build the complete executable task payload.
3. Explicitly identify `othoth77/spy` as the target repository.
4. Delegate implementation to an executor authorized to modify `othoth77/spy`.
5. Track execution state and returned evidence.
6. Collect test, commit, PR, deployment, and production-verification results.
7. Report the final state back through the Bridge.

[spy v2 execution scope]
The delegated executor must perform the complete SPY V2 lifecycle:

[phase 0 — baseline]
- Inspect current `othoth77/spy` repository state.
- Inspect existing SPY V2 work, branches, PRs, issues, tests, deployment state, and documentation.
- Establish a production baseline.

[phase 1 — gap analysis]
- Map SPY V2 requirements to the existing implementation.
- Identify missing engineering work.
- Produce an executable checklist and acceptance criteria.

[phase 2 — implementation]
- Implement all applicable SPY V2 engineering requirements.
- Preserve existing working behavior and backward compatibility.
- Cover orchestration, agent roles, research/execution/review flows, integrations, persistence, recovery, security, configuration, and documentation as applicable.

[phase 3 — verification]
- Run the complete test suite.
- Add or repair tests for changed behavior.
- Run integration/E2E tests.
- Verify failure and recovery paths.
- Resolve regressions.

[phase 4 — integration]
- Create the appropriate SPY V2 branch in `othoth77/spy`.
- Commit all implementation work.
- Push the branch.
- Create/update the appropriate PR.
- Resolve review findings.

[phase 5 — production]
- Deploy after successful preflight validation.
- Verify service health, logs, configuration, integrations, and resources.
- Run production smoke/E2E verification.
- Verify rollback/recovery readiness.

[phase 6 — acceptance]
Completion requires:
- Requirements implemented or explicitly isolated as external blockers.
- Tests passing.
- Production healthy.
- Deployment commit identified.
- Documentation updated.
- PR/commits traceable.
- Final evidence returned to the Bridge.

[bridge acceptance criteria]
The Bridge task is complete only when it has received and recorded:
- Target repository confirmation: `othoth77/spy`
- Delegated executor identity/profile
- Baseline result
- Implementation result
- Changed components/files summary
- Test results
- Commit SHA(s)
- PR reference
- Deployment result
- Production verification result
- Remaining blockers, if any
- Exact next action for unresolved external dependencies

[important]
Do not reproduce the previous failure mode from `gh-issue-472`.

That task incorrectly combined:
- `requested_action=investigate`
- `execution profile=repo-read`
- a full implementation objective
- an external repository target

This task must keep **orchestration** and **target-repository execution** explicitly separated.

If the delegated executor lacks authorization or access to `othoth77/spy`, report that precise dependency and do not pretend that SPY V2 implementation occurred. Continue any independent Bridge-side work that is possible.
